req.title: Partial update supported
req.statement: The system shall accept a partial payload on PUT /tasks/{task_id} and leave omitted fields unchanged.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the partial update functionality of the PUT /tasks/{task_id} endpoint. It includes tests for positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure comprehensive coverage. The tests are crafted to catch common mutation operators by asserting exact values, testing both sides of comparisons, and covering boundary conditions.

tests.name: test_partial_update_positive
preconditions: Task with id 1 exists in the database
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/1 with a partial payload to update the title
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.put(
    "/tasks/1",
    json={"title": "Read chapter 6"}
)

assert response.status_code == 200
updated_task = response.json()
assert updated_task['id'] == 1
assert updated_task['title'] == "Read chapter 6"
assert updated_task['description'] == "Signal pulse ember orbit harbo…"
assert updated_task['completed'] is True

tests.name: test_partial_update_negative
preconditions: Task with id 999 does not exist in the database
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/999 with a partial payload
expected: Error message indicating task not found
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.put(
    "/tasks/999",
    json={"title": "Non-existent task"}
)

assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.json()['detail'] == "Task with id 999 not found"

tests.name: test_partial_update_boundary
preconditions: Task with id 5 exists in the database
actions: Send a PUT request to /tasks/5 with an empty payload
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.put(
    "/tasks/5",
    json={}
)

assert response.status_code == 200
unchanged_task = response.json()
assert unchanged_task['id'] == 5
assert unchanged_task['title'] == "Write project report"
assert unchanged_task['description'] == "Signal cascade vertex cascade …"
assert unchanged_task['completed'] is False
